text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
AAARGGHHH!
Lost again!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Falco! One more match!
The one who becomes strongest on dirt is gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing~! But in return,
can Falco make one little request?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I have something very important to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Thrilling~♪ Exciting~♡
Umadol☆DIIIVE!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: H-H-H-Huuuuh~~!?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Cut! That's a great reaction, perfect for TV!
As expected of Falco-chan's friend!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I don't need your compliments!!
Besides, what was all that "favor of a lifetime" nonsense?! Doing this—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Like I explained, this is a nationwide broadcast!
Precious terrestrial TV!
A shoot that we absolutely cannot let fall through!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But the guest talent caught a cold!
Right now, Espo-san is the only one I can rely on~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, that was terrifying~!
What an insane height... Kyuuu.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
F-Falco-san~!?
Awawa... are we next?!
What should we do, Espo-san?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...All we gotta do is jump. Argh!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Don't go sayin' I'm the only one you can rely on
...jeez!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Tarumae! I'll show 'em a dive so easy-peasy
it completely tops Falco's!
I am——...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Espo-san!? Y-Your face!!

text_block_list.name: Assistant Director
text_block_list.text:
Uhm~, are you two ready to go?
If it's a no-go, we can totally discuss canceling...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: T-T-Totally easy-peasy!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~... That's a great attitude, but...
your body and mind aren't matching up... Uuun...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, leave the backup to me.
I'll jump down first and explain things to the directors!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae, here I gooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Assistant Director
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she made up her mind fast...
Normally, anyone's legs would freeze up like Espo-san's...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...L-L-Legs...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't you dare look away.
No matter how ya look at it, your legs are shakin', aren't they."

text_block_list.name: Young Espo
text_block_list.text:
T-They ain't shaking! 
I'm telling you, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: That's exactly what I'm sayin' ain't gonna cut it!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Why can't you admit your own weakness!
That's important too! Don't push yourself past your limits!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm not... shaking.
I am...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Even I can...——!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: DON'T UNDERESTIMATE MEEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...! Amazing, amazing!
As expected of Espo-san!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No way, incredible.
Even though she turned so pale earlier...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Hey, how's that!
Didja see that?! I can—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "I'll jump as many times as it takes!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the TV that was casually switched on,
Espoir City could be seen diving from the platform.
